question: Gully is the ______ position in cricket.
solution:
The correct answer is __**between point and slip**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Gully: It is a part of the cricket field where fielders stand between point and slip. It is located on the offside just behind the square of the wicket.
